text:
Maria G: quick heads-up — PR #4321 edits the UX wording for the generation API and includes a link to an old glossary entry that we've deprecated. can we decide before merge?

Ajay P: saw that. the param rename from 'voice' -> 'tone' is fine, but we need to standardize on 'voice' vs 'tone' in the guide first. which one do we prefer for SDK samples?

Samira L: +1 on standardizing. my vote is 'tone' for high-level docs and 'voice' for product feature names. but we should add that to the glossary and a tiny note in the style guide.

Kevin H: fwiw the SDK snippet in the PR uses `voice: "friendly"` so if we switch to 'tone' we'll need to update code samples across repo. quick grep: ```git grep -n \"voice:\" docs/ sdk/ | wc -l``` — we should run that before deciding.

Lexi C: I'll patch the snippet if we pick 'tone'. prefer minimal churn so fewer line changes in the PR. also found one broken link -> points to /glossary/voice when we moved entries to /glossary/phrasing.

DocsBot: PR #4321: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 (updated 2 hours ago) :white_check_mark:

Maria G: proposal: 1) adopt 'tone' in docs main copy 2) add alias note in glossary entry so 'voice' searches redirect 3) update SDK snippets in the PR to use 'tone' and add a brief comment. thoughts?

Ajay P: sounds good. also add a one‑line migration note in the migration guide (docs/migration/terminology.md) so integrators know about naming change.

Samira L: I can create the glossary patch — will add alias and a line about intended usage. tagging @Lexi to update the SDK snippet in the PR after Samira posts the glossary change.

Lexi C: on it. I'll also run Kevin's grep and paste results here.

Kevin H: grep output: ```docs/: 12
sdk/: 8
examples/: 3
``` so ~23 occurrences. most are in examples and tests. Patch plan: change the docs top-level copy now, run tests, then update SDK snippets in the PR.

Maria G: timeline: Samira updates glossary by EOD, Lexi pushes snippet update in PR after that, Ajay will add migration note (small). I'll keep the PR as draft until all three land.

Samira L: glossary PR created: #210 — includes alias and guidance. short excerpt: "tone (preferred) — use for user-facing phrasing guidance. voice — legacy, listed as alias."

Lexi C: pushed snippet change to PR and updated the broken link to /glossary/phrasing. small test failing in examples, fixing now. :wrench:

Kevin H: re-ran quick checks, updated tests pass locally.

Maria G: awesome — can someone add a one-line note to the release notes about the terminology tweak so platform teams know? Ajay?

Ajay P: will add a blurb to the release notes draft and ping support to highlight in the migration FAQ.

Maria G: thanks everyone. leaving PR in draft until release note + glossary + snippet are merged. :thumbsup:
